bugs.title: Dashboard loss values are not shown in red
bugs.evidence: Dashboard Net Profit card shows '-OMR 6,926.364', but the text colour is rgb(15,23,42), which is slate-900, not rose-600. In KpiCard.jsx the Money value gets className 'text-slate-900'. tailwind-merge (cn) in Money.jsx keeps that last colour class and drops text-rose-600/text-emerald-600. Only the thin top bar turns rose. Frontend-only: GET /api/dashboard returns correct values, and the UI shows the same numbers. Screenshot: dashboard-cards-and-trend-failure.png. Fix: remove text-slate-900 from the KpiCard Money className, or apply it only when signed is false.

checks.criterion: backend suite (auth, dashboard, crud, cogs, profit, reports)
checks.name: e1_tests (excluding zz_clear_sample)
auth-login-and-guard
checks.evidence: No signup link on Login. A wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password'. Correct login opens the main content. Logout returns to Login. /signup shows no signup form.

checks.name: dashboard-cards-and-trend
checks.evidence: All 5 cards show 'OMR x,xxx.xxx' and the trend chart renders. Net Profit '-OMR 6,926.364' is shown in rgb(15,23,42), not red.

checks.name: category-crud-validation
checks.evidence: Field counts match on all 18 pages. Utilities type offers Electricity, Water and Gas. Inline 'Required' and 'Must be greater than 0' block saving. Sale 10 x 12.5 shows a 125.000 row at the top. Editing qty to 4 gives 50.000. Delete removes the row.

checks.name: cogs-rules-ui
checks.evidence: Resin consumption of 100 at a purchase cost of 1.5 shows 150.000. The never-purchased material row shows 'No purchase cost found' with 0.000. Finished goods 40 units costing 100 show cost per unit 2.500.

checks.name: reports-profit-ui
checks.evidence: For May to Oct 2026, the Gross, Operating and Net Profit KPI cards and the Total row match /api/reports/pnl to the baisa, and the formulas hold.

checks.name: reports-table-charts
checks.evidence: May to Jul shows 3 rows plus Total, with 7 value columns. The bar and line charts render. No horizontal overflow at 1280px or 1024px. June daily view shows 30 rows plus Total, and mid-month operating expenses are not zero.

checks.name: reports-empty-invalid
checks.evidence: Feb 2099 shows 'No data for this period' and OMR 0.000. Start after end shows 'Start date must be before end date'.

checks.name: settings-clear-sample
checks.evidence: No Reload button. The confirmation dialog appears, and Cancel keeps the data. After confirming, the sample count is 0, the sales list has no sample badge, the own tscheck record remains, and Dashboard revenue is OMR 0.000.
